_comments: A-US6(i) / golive #162 — THE MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION POST. Same action, same mechanism and same
waiver as the nightly job (.accounting-post-orders-payments-nightly.json); only the cadence,
the cutoff mode and the include-list differ. Read that file's comments first.
· CronExpression `0 0 3 1 * *` — 03:00:00 UTC on the 1st of each month, after midnight per
the story and behind both the nightly post (01:00) and the ERP master-data sync (02:00).
· CutoffMode PriorMonth resolves to the LAST DAY of the prior month at midnight UTC, which
pendingCandidateFilter turns into `EffectiveDate < the 1st of this month` — the just-closed
month is included, the current month waits for next month's run.
· RevenueRecognition entries are written at BOOKING, one per future period, forward-dated to
their RecognitionDate. Nothing generates them monthly; this job only sweeps the ones whose
date has arrived. A back-dated term therefore drops several past-dated periods in at once
and they catch up in a single batch, with no special handling — selection is purely date +
status. There is no order-status gate, by design (#162).
· MaxRuntimeMinutes 240, four times the nightly job. A single long-running action CANNOT
heartbeat mid-call (ActionScheduledJobDriver's own documented caveat), so the acquire-time
lease has to cover the whole run — and month-end catch-up, with multi-period back-dated
terms across every company, is the largest batch of the year. Overshooting costs nothing:
the ceiling only bounds a hung run, and ConcurrencyMode Skip means the next month's run
would be skipped rather than doubled if one ever came close.

fields.Name: Accounting — Post Subscription revenue recognition (monthly)
fields.Description: Builds and dispatches a single-company batch of the Pending RevenueRecognition journal entries dated before the 1st of the current month, for every company with candidates. Includes back-dated catch-up periods. Unattended: no CFO approval Task, per the scheduled-posting waiver.
